title: Space bound for the silent simulation
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean-symbol Turing machine with $m$ work tapes, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $y$. Let $b$ be a Boolean tag such that the input-head position of $c$ is $0$ only if $b$ is false, and is $|y|+1$ only if $b$ is true. For any Boolean word $x$, any input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ positions, any Boolean lists $u$ and $v$, and any $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the total number of distinct cells visited by the work-tape heads of the silent simulation of $M$ from the configuration built from $c,b,p,u,v$, through time $t$, is at most the number visited by $M$ from $c$ through time $t$, plus $|y|+2+|u\mathbin{++}(M\text{'s output after }t\text{ steps from }c)|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean tag $b$ satisfying the two boundary implications for $c$'s input-head position
